title: Clothes in the hamper

steps.text: Find dirty clothes on the floor or bed.

steps.tip: Make a small pile in your arms so nothing drops.

steps.text: Put every piece in the hamper.
steps.tip: Clean clothes that fell stay on the bed or go back in a drawer.

done_when: No dirty clothes on the floor
Hamper is not overflowing onto the floor
parent_notes: Teach the difference between dirty laundry and clean clothes that just fell.
